articles.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Molecular Precision: Mechanistic Insight & RNP Delivery
articles.summary: In-depth molecular analysis of Cas9 endonuclease ribonucleoprotein complex, PAM recognition (5'-NGG-3'), and double-strand break repair via NHEJ versus HDR.
articles.content:
Molecular Structure of Cas9 Endonuclease

Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9) is a multi-domain endonuclease that associates with a chimeric single guide RNA (sgRNA). Cas9 comprises two structural lobes: the Recognition (REC) lobe and the Nuclease (NUC) lobe.

PAM Recognition & Strand Cleavage

Target search involves scanning genomic DNA for the 5'-NGG-3' protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) by the PAM-interacting domain (PID). Strand separation is initiated, followed by RNA-DNA hybridization.

opportunities.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Structural Biology & Cryo-EM
opportunities.description: DST-SERB sponsored project investigating viral envelope glycoproteins using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy and biochemical reconstitution.
opportunities.eligibility: M.Sc. in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences with CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS) or valid GATE score.
opportunities.qualification: Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences with national entrance qualification.

opportunities.title: Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship Programme (SRFP)
opportunities.description: Two-month prestigious summer research fellowship under fellowship guides across national institutions (IISc, TIFR, IITs, CSIR institutes).
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate biotechnology and life sciences students with minimum 65% aggregate score.
opportunities.qualification: B.Sc. (2nd/3rd year), M.Sc. (1st year), or B.Tech (3rd year)

opportunities.title: DBT-Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF / BET)
opportunities.organization: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Govt. of India
opportunities.description: National fellowship award for doctoral research across universities and national laboratories in biotechnology and allied disciplines.
opportunities.eligibility: M.Sc. / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Life Sciences with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwD).
opportunities.qualification: Postgraduate qualification in Biotechnology / Life Sciences

examinations.conductingAgency: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB)
examinations.syllabusSummary: Section A: 10+2 level Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology. Section B: Graduate level Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Genetics, Microbiology, and Bioinformatics.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: Bachelor degree in Biotechnology or allied biological disciplines with minimum 60% aggregate (55% for reserved categories).
examinations.examPattern: Computer Based Test (CBT), 180 Minutes. Section A: 60 compulsory questions. Section B: 100 questions (candidate attempts any 60).
examinations.importantDatesText: 2026 cycle concluded (Exam held 17 May 2026). Official 2027 session bulletin expected early 2027.
examinations.statusNote: Admissions for 2026 participating institutions concluded. Official 2027 notification awaited.

examinations.syllabusSummary: Section A: General Aptitude & General Biotechnology. Section B: Specialized subjects in Agricultural, Animal, Medical, Environmental, and Industrial Biotechnology.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: M.Sc. / M.Tech / M.V.Sc. in Biotechnology or allied subjects with 60% marks. Age limit 28 years (relaxation as per GOI rules).
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 180 Minutes. Section A: 50 compulsory questions. Section B: 150 questions (attempt 50). Total 100 questions.
examinations.markingScheme: +3 marks for correct, -1 mark for incorrect.
examinations.importantDatesText: Annual examination cycle. 2027 notification scheduled for announcement by NTA/DBT.
examinations.statusNote: Category-I (top 275) awarded DBT-JRF fellowship. Category-II eligible for project employment.

examinations.fullName: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering - Biotechnology
examinations.syllabusSummary: General Aptitude, Engineering Mathematics, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology & Genetics, Bioprocess Engineering, Plant & Animal Biotech, Recombinant DNA, Computational Biology.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: Candidates in 3rd/final year or completed Bachelor degree in Engineering / Technology or M.Sc. in Science subjects.
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 180 Minutes, 65 questions (10 General Aptitude + 55 Subject specific). Combination of MCQs, MSQs, and NATs.
examinations.markingScheme: 1-mark and 2-mark questions. MCQs have negative marking (1/3rd or 2/3rd). MSQs and NATs have ZERO negative marking.
examinations.importantDatesText: Annual national examination held in February.
examinations.statusNote: Score card valid for 3 years for M.Tech admissions and PSU recruitment.

examinations.fullName: Joint Admission Test for Masters - Biotechnology (BT)
examinations.syllabusSummary: Biology (44%), Chemistry (20%), Mathematics (18%), Physics (18%) at 10+2 and undergraduate level.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: Undergraduate degree with no minimum aggregate mark requirement (only pass required per revised IIT JAM norms).
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 180 Minutes, 60 questions divided into Section A (MCQs), Section B (MSQs), Section C (NATs).
examinations.markingScheme: Section A: Negative marking. Section B & C: No negative marking.
examinations.importantDatesText: Annual exam conducted in February across Indian centers.
examinations.statusNote: Admission into M.Sc., Joint M.Sc.-Ph.D. at IITs and Integrated Ph.D. at IISc.

examinations.fullName: Common University Entrance Test (Postgraduate) - Life Sciences (SCQP17)
examinations.syllabusSummary: Microbiology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Plant Physiology, Animal Physiology, Ecology, Evolution, Techniques in Biology.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: Bachelor degree in Science with biological subjects from a recognized university.
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 105 Minutes, 75 domain-specific questions (General Part A removed from 2024 onwards).
examinations.importantDatesText: Conducted annually in March for central and participating state universities.
examinations.statusNote: Single entrance gateway for JNU, BHU, DU, Hyd University M.Sc. Life Sciences / Biotechnology programs.

examinations.fullName: Joint CSIR-UGC NET for JRF and Lectureship - Life Sciences
examinations.conductingAgency: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of CSIR
examinations.syllabusSummary: 13 Comprehensive Units: Molecules, Cellular Organization, Fundamental Processes, Cell Communication, Developmental Biology, System Physiology (Plant/Animal), Inheritance Biology, Diversity of Life, Ecological Principles, Evolution, Applied Biology, Methods in Biology.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Life Sciences with 55% marks (50% for reserved categories).
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 180 Minutes. Part A (General Aptitude, 20 Qs, attempt 15), Part B (Core Concepts, 50 Qs, attempt 35), Part C (Analytical Research, 75 Qs, attempt 25).
examinations.importantDatesText: Conducted twice annually (June and December cycles).
examinations.statusNote: Qualifies candidates for CSIR/UGC Junior Research Fellowship and Assistant Professor eligibility across India.
